doc.title: Scott Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe,Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997

title: Choosing the album title Thinking Big
summary: They discuss Thinking Big versus The Big Picture.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Well I used the title “Thinking Big” for the record, but the other title I was thinking of was “The Big Picture.” Which do you prefer?
I like “Thinking Big” actually. “The Big Picture” looks too much like some corporate thing — you know, looking down the road, what’s our product going to be in twenty years.
Oh I wouldn’t think of it like that. I would think of it like, you know, the universe. That’s how I would think of it. And of course the saxophone.
